data.title: Turn one source pack into Excel, a memo and slides
data.summary: Reuse the same reviewed evidence across three deliverables, with a shared figures table and visible missing information.

facts.text: Claude's file-creation feature can produce downloadable XLSX, PPTX, DOCX and PDF files from supplied material when code execution/file creation is enabled.

Box describes a deployed Claude Skills integration that turns retrieved company documents into draft slides and spreadsheets. Its integration is a provider-reported customer example, not a Sintra implementation.

sources.title: Create and edit files with Claude
Box: document creation with Claude Skills

prerequisites: Claude file creation available under your account/organization settings.
Authorized source documents and an existing reporting template where available.
steps: Attach the source pack and name its reporting period and audience. Identify existing output files to update.
Request a source inventory and a figures table: metric, amount, unit, period, document and page/section.
Review that table before generating deliverables. Keep missing values as missing.
Ask for a workbook with inputs separated from calculations, a short memo and a deck using only the reviewed figures.
Open the actual output files. Recalculate formulas and compare each material number across all three formats.
Review the narrative and slide layout; save the deliverables with the source inventory and unresolved questions.
data.output: An XLSX, a short memo and a PPTX grounded in one reviewed figures table.
validation: The same metric, unit and period agree across all deliverables.
Workbook formulas recalculate; slides render legibly and cite the source pack.
limitations: Recipe not executed in Claude by Sintra; a generated file is not proof of correct contents.
The Box architecture and reported outcomes are not reproduced. Treat generated charts and summaries as drafts.
data.prompt: Use this authorized source pack for [period/audience]. First return a source inventory and figures table with units and page/section citations. After my review, update the existing [workbook/template], create a one-page memo and draft a PPTX using exactly those figures. Keep missing values visible. Return a cross-format consistency checklist and the actual downloadable files.

replication.environment: Claude file creation + Excel/PowerPoint for review
replication.useWhen: Produce a consistent reporting pack from a small authorized source set.

inputs.name: Source pack
inputs.detail: Dated documents or an explicit synthetic input table; identify authoritative versions.

inputs.name: Existing templates
inputs.detail: Workbook/deck templates, audience and required output formats.

launch: Open a Claude conversation with file creation available and attach the approved inputs.
Ask for the figures table first; generate formats after its review.

practice.task: Use a synthetic note: FY2026 revenue EUR 120, prior year EUR 100; operating costs not supplied.
practice.expected: All formats show 20% revenue growth; costs remain missing and no margin is invented.

acceptanceTests.expected: Show both versions with dates and ask which is authoritative.

acceptanceTests.scenario: A slide number differs from the workbook
acceptanceTests.expected: Flag the mismatch and withhold the pack from final use.

troubleshooting.action: Check file-creation availability and request the actual XLSX/PPTX artifacts explicitly.

troubleshooting.symptom: A formula is only a hard-coded value
troubleshooting.action: Ask for formula-driven calculations and recalculate in Excel.
